GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Fire, security & access

We organise agreed work to fire protection, security and access systems with the site manager and relevant service providers. We identify the equipment involved, review existing records and coordinate any isolation or access restrictions. Inspection, repair and certification are recorded as separate parts of the scope.

What we can look after

  • Fire doors, associated hardware and agreed rectification items.
  • Access control, locks and security equipment maintenance.

Planning the work

  1. We confirm the equipment, reported defect and existing service information.
  2. We agree access, temporary arrangements and required system coordination.
  3. We document the completed work and hand over the relevant service records.

Questions about this service

Can you include fire door repairs in a maintenance visit?+

We review the door, hardware, defect report and required work first. We then confirm the appropriate repair scope and documentation, and coordinate any separate inspection or service attendance that the work requires.
